anonymous_auth_enabled.title: Anonymous Authentication Enabled
anonymous_auth_enabled.description: Whether the API server allows unauthenticated (anonymous) requests via --anonymous-auth=true flag. When true, requests without valid credentials are processed as system:anonymous.

workload_to_apiserver_network_policy_enf.title: Workload-to-API-Server Network Policy Enforced
workload_to_apiserver_network_policy_enf.description: Whether NetworkPolicy or equivalent firewall rules restrict workload pods from directly reaching the API server endpoint (typically port 6443). True means traffic is restricted.

mutual_tls_enforced.title: Mutual TLS Enforced on API Server
mutual_tls_enforced.description: Whether the API server requires client certificate authentication (mTLS) for all connections, meaning both --client-ca-file is configured and clients must present valid certificates.

api_server_insecure_port.title: API Server Insecure Port
api_server_insecure_port.description: Port number on which the API server listens for HTTP (non-TLS) requests via --insecure-port. A value of 0 means disabled. Non-zero values expose the API server without TLS or authentication.

etcd_listen_address_scope.title: etcd Listen Address Scope
etcd_listen_address_scope.description: Indicates which network interfaces etcd is bound to: control-plane-only (loopback or dedicated control plane interface), node-network (reachable from all nodes), or all-interfaces (0.0.0.0, reachable from workload and node networks).

firewall_restricts_etcd_to_control_plane.title: Firewall Restricts etcd Ingress to Control Plane Zone
firewall_restricts_etcd_to_control_plane.description: Whether host-level or network-level firewall rules enforce that etcd client ports (default 2379) and peer ports (default 2380) accept connections only from control plane segment source addresses.

bound_subject_types.title: Bound Subject Types
bound_subject_types.description: List of subject kinds bound by the ClusterRoleBinding (e.g., ServiceAccount, User, Group). Identifies whether workload-level identities such as ServiceAccounts are granted cluster-wide roles.

granted_verbs.title: Granted Verbs
granted_verbs.description: Set of verbs explicitly granted by the ClusterRole referenced in the binding (e.g., get, list, watch, create, update, delete, '*'). Broad or wildcard verbs on sensitive resources indicate privilege escalation risk.

granted_resources.title: Granted Resources
granted_resources.description: Set of Kubernetes resource types explicitly granted by the ClusterRole (e.g., secrets, pods, nodes, '*'). Sensitive resource types or wildcard grants expand the blast radius of a compromised workload identity.

subject_namespace.title: Subject Service Account Namespace
subject_namespace.description: Namespace of the ServiceAccount subject bound by the ClusterRoleBinding or RoleBinding. Workload namespaces receiving cluster-wide grants represent cross-boundary privilege propagation.

webhook_failure_policy.title: Webhook Failure Policy
webhook_failure_policy.description: The failurePolicy setting on the admission webhook configuration, determining behavior when the webhook endpoint is unreachable. 'Ignore' allows requests to proceed; 'Fail' blocks them.

namespace_selector_exempts_system_namesp.title: Namespace Selector Exempts System Namespaces
namespace_selector_exempts_system_namesp.description: Whether the webhook's namespaceSelector excludes kube-system, kube-public, or other privileged namespaces, leaving those namespaces uncovered by policy enforcement.

webhook_match_policy.title: Webhook Match Policy
webhook_match_policy.description: The matchPolicy field controlling how the webhook matches requests. 'Exact' may miss equivalent API group/version requests, leaving coverage gaps for resources accessed via different API versions.

uncovered_resource_types.title: Uncovered Resource Types
uncovered_resource_types.description: List of high-risk resource types (e.g., pods, deployments, secrets, serviceaccounts) not covered by any admission webhook rule, leaving them without policy enforcement.

automount_service_account_token.title: Auto-Mount Service Account Token Enabled
automount_service_account_token.description: Indicates whether the pod spec or service account object has automountServiceAccountToken set to true (or unset, defaulting to true), causing API server credentials to be automatically injected into pod filesystems.

service_account_has_elevated_rbac.title: Service Account Has Elevated RBAC Permissions
service_account_has_elevated_rbac.description: Indicates whether the service account bound to the pod has ClusterRole or Role bindings granting permissions beyond minimal read-only access (e.g., write permissions or access to sensitive resources).

workload_namespace_trust_zone.title: Workload Namespace Trust Zone Classification
workload_namespace_trust_zone.description: The trust zone classification of the namespace in which the pod runs, indicating the sensitivity of the environment and the risk of credential exposure.

foreign_namespace_subjects_in_rolebindin.title: Foreign Namespace Subjects in RoleBindings
foreign_namespace_subjects_in_rolebindin.description: Indicates whether any RoleBinding in a tenant namespace references subjects (ServiceAccounts or Groups) originating from a different tenant namespace.

role_grants_cluster_scoped_resources.title: Role Grants Access to Cluster-Scoped Resources
role_grants_cluster_scoped_resources.description: Indicates whether any Role (namespace-scoped) in a tenant namespace includes rules that reference cluster-scoped resource types (e.g., nodes, persistentvolumes, clusterroles, namespaces).

high_privilege_kubeconfig_zones.title: High-Privilege Kubeconfig Storage Zones
high_privilege_kubeconfig_zones.description: List of trust zones where high-privilege kubeconfig files (cluster-admin or broad namespace rights) are stored or accessible, such as 'ci_cd_runner', 'developer_workstation', 'workload_namespace', 'monitoring_agent', 'control_plane'.

workload_zone_credential_store_accessibl.title: Workload Zone Can Access Control-Plane Credential Store
workload_zone_credential_store_accessibl.description: Whether systems or pods running in workload namespaces or lower-trust zones have network or API access to the credential store that holds control-plane-scoped kubeconfig files or service account tokens.

credential_scope.title: Credential Privilege Scope
credential_scope.description: The privilege scope of the exposed or potentially exposed kubeconfig/service account credential.

network_policy_restricts_control_plane_i.title: NetworkPolicy Restricts Control Plane Ingress
network_policy_restricts_control_plane_i.description: Whether a Kubernetes NetworkPolicy exists that explicitly denies or limits workload pod/namespace access to control plane ports (e.g., 6443, 2379, 2380, 10259, 10257).

external_firewall_restricts_control_plan.title: External Firewall Restricts Control Plane Ingress
external_firewall_restricts_control_plan.description: Whether an external firewall (cloud security group, ACL, host firewall) enforces rules preventing arbitrary workload nodes or pod CIDRs from reaching control plane endpoints on administrative ports.

audit_policy_sensitive_resources_log_lev.title: Audit Policy Log Level for Sensitive Resources
audit_policy_sensitive_resources_log_lev.description: The audit log level applied to sensitive control plane resources (secrets, clusterrolebindings, pods/exec) in the Kubernetes audit policy. Indicates whether boundary-crossing events are captured.

audit_log_path_configured.title: Audit Log Path Configured
audit_log_path_configured.description: Whether the API server is configured with a valid --audit-log-path or --audit-webhook-config-file, meaning audit logging is active at all.

audit_policy_file_present.title: Audit Policy File Present
audit_policy_file_present.description: Whether a structured audit policy file is referenced by the API server (--audit-policy-file flag). If absent, no fine-grained audit rules exist.

bind_address_non_loopback.title: Scheduler/Controller Manager Bound to Non-Loopback Address
bind_address_non_loopback.description: Indicates whether kube-scheduler or kube-controller-manager is configured with --bind-address set to a non-loopback address (e.g., 0.0.0.0 or a node IP), exposing health/metrics endpoints beyond localhost.

authentication_disabled_on_endpoint.title: Authentication Disabled on Health/Metrics Endpoint
authentication_disabled_on_endpoint.description: Indicates whether the exposed health or metrics endpoint has authentication disabled, either via --authentication-kubeconfig being absent/empty, --authentication-skip-lookup=true, or the deprecated --port being set to a non-zero value.
